title: Fixed rules goes back to Part Number A to Z after you leave and come back
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA10 b-cat) exists.
  • Category {Category-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA10 a-cat) exists.
  • Fixed rule part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA10-1) is at {Location-A} in category {Category-A} with fixed price (for example 15.00).
  • Fixed rule part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA10-2) is at {Location-A} in category {Category-B} with fixed price (for example 15.00).
  • You are on a page other than Pricing and the Pricing Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Fixed rules tab.
  3. Wait until the loading indicator on the Fixed rules tab disappears.
  4. Click the Category column header.
  5. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  6. Read the arrows and the order of {Part-A} and {Part-B}.
  7. Click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  8. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  9. Click the Fixed rules tab.
  10. Wait until the loading indicator on the Fixed rules tab disappears.
  11. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  12. Read the arrows and the order of {Part-A} and {Part-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: only Category shows an arrow, pointing up, and {Part-B} ({Category-B}) is above {Part-A}.
  • Step 12: only Part Number shows an arrow, pointing up, and {Part-A} is above {Part-B}. The Category sort was not kept.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10136 (Story 3, Fixed Rules, sortable columns; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S3-R12a (fresh open), §5 Terminology, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.4 (Fixed rules - before and after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R12a: “When the tab reloads in place, the sort the user chose stays applied and the header arrow stays where it was. Opening the page afresh returns the list to Part number ascending.”
  • PRD §5 Terminology: “Fresh open - the user arrives at the page again, having been somewhere else.”
